scope: Controlled graphical host and directly tested local presentation/storage components, not a complete Atoll fork. No DynamicNotch source has been copied into this host.

files.modifications: Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. Propagate hover preference changes to existing display presenters immediately.

Adapted getClosedNotchSize measurement ideas into pure display inputs and screen-relative layout; added external floating capsule placement and size bounds. Test-driven fix: preserve menu-bar clearance by bounding panel height below its top edge; compress margins on synthetic tiny frames. Menu-bar clearance: place both complete window rectangles below the maximum safe-area, visible-frame and explicit menu-height band; bound compact/expanded bodies to usable space, and reject unusable geometry. Camera width is metadata, not a content spacer. Notch-sized placement (0.1.3): replaces the below-menu-band placement, which covered application content. On notched displays the compact window equals the public camera-housing rectangle at the top edge, which holds no menus or status items; implausible housing metadata falls back to a bounded width. Non-notched displays use a small pill inset inside the menu-bar center. Only the user-opened expanded state extends across the menu row; expanded content starts below the housing.

files.modifications: Adapted nonactivating panel configuration; replaced upstream managers with per-display presenter and shared local coordinator; removed capture/defaults registration and global services. Extracted original local presentation state into separately tested IslandPresentation.swift. Hover responsiveness: one stable native tracking host per panel, reconcile the actual cursor after events/show/resize, stop tracking before hide/close, and apply preference changes immediately. Refresh public screen/status-bar geometry on show/update/expansion and hide an unusable layout before activating native tracking; menu-row pixels contain no island window. Notch placement (0.1.3): panel level above status items so an open island draws over the menu row; explicit mouse-event receipt for the visually empty notch target; pointer reconciliation includes the display's top edge.

files.modifications: Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. Native presenter owns hover events; SwiftUI content animation shortened to 120ms, respecting Reduce Motion. Move compact tray/Shelf/count content below the system menu band and remove camera-gap and extra notch-height content padding. Notch placement (0.1.3): compact notch state draws no visible content; non-notched compact state is a tray/count pill; expanded content is inset below the camera housing.
